component.name: KyPost
component.summary: Relay-based email client for KDE Plasma and Plasma Mobile

description.p: KyPost is a relay-only email client for KDE Plasma and Plasma Mobile. It does not speak IMAP or SMTP directly; instead, all mail and contacts sync through a KyPost relay backend, which also brokers device pairing and push notifications over UnifiedPush. The relay a device talks to is whichever one its pairing link points at, so self-hosted instances work the same way as the hosted service.

The app provides an inbox and message detail view, server-side folders, an HTML composer for replying, forwarding, and sending new mail with attachments and drafts, and a contacts list with a detail/edit view. Pairing a new device with the relay account is done by pasting or opening a pairing link. PGP public keys can be exchanged with other devices by QR code, and end-to-end encrypted mail this app cannot read is explained rather than shown blank.

Optional security features: a PIN lock with lockout and wipe-on-repeated-failure, encrypting the pairing credential behind that PIN, trust-on-first-use TLS certificate pinning, and a mode that keeps no mail or contacts on disk at all.
